title: 第7章 争锋第8章 香喷喷的烤鱼
slug: 夫人她只想修仙第370章自爆
content_zh:
掌门收了个毫无根基的凡人做亲传弟子，更有甚者言，掌门会将她做为关门弟子照料。
当年天资纵横如沈云熠也是掌门亲自收为徒，但可没有这么费劲，一来二去劝了好多句，这么看来，颜筝的地位恐还在沈云熠之上！
“别放屁！
小爷我如今是筑基，颜筝她现在会炼气吗？无论怎么看，师尊都不会越过我！”
沈云熠手中的树枝狠狠砸在身侧的那人头上。
那人痛呼一声，却不敢反驳，连连点头：“是是是！
掌门肯定更看好您！
您可是咱北山宗年轻一代的榜样，北山宗上下都只认您这个小师兄，不认她那个小师姐！
我们也知道，小师兄您宽宏大量，向来不把这种无关紧要的人放在心上！
但小师兄，让那个凡人如此消遥自在，咱们这些做师弟的也不甘心呐！”
“哦？你们想干什么？”
沈云熠好像来了兴致，笑眯眯地问。
立刻有人笑着上前：“小师兄！
您性子温和随行，不在乎被这凡人压了一头，师弟们可不甘心！
我们想着，在那凡人的饭菜中下那所谓的泻药，好让她吃吃苦头！”
沈云熠眉心一跳，似笑非笑：“你们干完了？”
“唉！
没有！
不知道为何，那凡人这三天都没来食堂，我们一直没找到合适的时机。”
先前说话的弟子一把推开回话的胖子，笑得谄媚：“小师兄您放心！

我们肯定不会放过她！
她毕竟只是凡人，三天不吃已经快到极限了，我们三日夜守在食堂，一有消息立马动手！
给小师兄出气！”
“给我出气？”
沈云熠挑了挑眉，倚着假石，手里无意识地捻动树枝，语气莫名，“当真？”
“当真！
当真！”
三人连连点头，满脸真切，看样子恨不得给沈云熠跪下以表忠心。
沈云熠笑着起身。
“哎呀？你们对我还真是忠心耿耿——”
三人脸上皆得一喜。
content_en:
The headmaster accepted a mortal with no foundation as his direct disciple. What's more, the headmaster said that he would take care of her as a closed disciple.
At that time, the head of Shen Yunyi, who was as talented as Shen Yunyi, personally accepted him as his disciple, but he didn't go to such trouble. He tried to persuade him a lot. From this point of view, Yan Zheng's status may still be higher than Shen Yunyi's!
"Don't fart!
Young Master, I am building foundation now, can Yan Zheng know how to refine Qi now? No matter how you look at it, Master will never go beyond me! "
The branch in Shen Yunyi's hand hit the man beside him on the head hard.
The man screamed in pain, but did not dare to refute, and nodded repeatedly: "Yes, yes!
The boss will definitely be more optimistic about you!
You are a role model for the younger generation of our Beishan Sect. Everyone in the Beishan Sect only recognizes you as the little senior brother and not her little senior sister!
We also know that, little senior brother, you are magnanimous and never take such insignificant people to your heart!
But little senior brother, we junior fellow apprentices are not willing to let that mortal man be so far away and at ease! "
"Oh? What do you want to do?"
Shen Yunyi seemed to be interested and asked with a smile.
Someone immediately came forward with a smile: "Little senior brother!
You have a gentle temperament and don't care about being overpowered by this mortal. Junior brothers are not willing to accept it!
We thought about putting so-called laxatives in that mortal's food so that she would suffer! "
Chen Yunyi's eyebrows twitched and he smiled half-heartedly: "Are you done?"
"Alas!
No!
For some reason, that mortal hasn't come to the canteen in the past three days, and we haven't found the right time. "
The disciple who spoke earlier pushed away the fat man who was replying, and smiled flatteringly: "Don't worry, little senior brother!
We definitely won't let her go!
After all, she is only a human being. She has reached her limit without eating for three days. We stayed in the cafeteria for three days and nights, and we immediately took action as soon as there was news!
Take it out on your little senior brother! "
"Taking it out on me?"
Shen Yunyi raised his eyebrows, leaning on the fake stone, twisting the branches unconsciously in his hands, and said in an incomprehensible tone, "Seriously?"
"Seriously!
Seriously! "
The three of them nodded repeatedly, with sincere expressions on their faces, as if they wanted to kneel down to Shen Yunyi to show their loyalty.
Shen Yunyi stood up with a smile.
"Oh? You are really loyal to me——"
All three of them had a happy expression on their faces.
